reasons: BLOCKING ASYMMETRY. narration.en.sentences[5] (id "v-6") asserts the displacement mechanism in artifact voice, in EN only, after the artifact everywhere else declines to assert it. The sentence reads: "Standing outside the frame: the ratio between those two series, whether the recording base held across both years, THE CHANNELS ABSORBING WHAT THE BLOCKED RAILS LOSE, the path of the series before the push, ...". "the channels absorbing X" is indicative: it presupposes that channels exist and are taking up the flow that left the recorded series. Three comparisons show this is a dropped hedge, not house register. (a) The card it points at, panels[0].hidden[2] (jt-h3-displaced-channels).why_hidden.en, uses the conditional for the same set: "never name the channels THAT WOULD CARRY the flow the blocked rails lose". (b) The ID counterpart, narration.id.sentences[3] (id "v-4"), carries no absorption participle at all: "kanal pembayaran di luar jalur yang diblokir" (payment channels outside the blocked rails) names only location. (c) The same EN sentence proves the hedged form was available and in use: the adjacent item on the branch that cuts both ways is written open, "WHETHER the recording base held across both years". So the hedging discipline applied to the bidirectional branch is dropped on the branch that cuts only against the gov framing, in one language. The other six items in the list presuppose only trivia (a ratio, a path, a matching quarter, people, an outflow); this one presupposes the contested mechanism the registry does not carry. The frame "Standing outside the frame:" marks the items unexamined, not hypothetical, so it does not neutralise the presupposition. Net effect: the artifact's own summarising voice commits the class of unsupported join it spends three edges mapping, in the opposite direction. FIX: restore the conditional in narration.en v-6 to match jt-h3's own EN why, e.g. "the channels that would carry what the blocked rails lose". No other field needs to move.

SECONDARY, non-blocking, fix at author's discretion while in there: narration.id.sentences[3] (v-4) renders jt-h2 as "porsi pasar yang MASIH terjangkau alat pencatat", where the card's own label (panels[0].hidden[1].label.id) is "Porsi pasar yang terjangkau alat pencatat PPATK" and its why frames an open question in both languages. "masih" can read aspectually and is defensible, but it leans toward a diminishing recording reach, the same substantive direction as the EN slip above. Reported so the fixer sees the narration layer is where both drifts sit; I did not treat it as independently blocking.

(2) jt-h3 why_hidden.en "does not, by itself, stop moving" now matches why_hidden.id "tidak dengan sendirinya berhenti bergerak": same hedge, same strength.

CLEARED, dimension 1 (edge statuses). Statuses follow one rule applied uniformly: a family member asserts the join but no registry source substantiates it -> unsourced (jt-e1, ev = Kompas era headline; jt-e2, ev = CNBC "Tersisa"); no family member asserts the join at all -> missing (jt-e3). Mirror constructed (same four sources, lean flipped to a displacement/"fall is a recording artifact" family) gets the same statuses from the same evidence: its displacement-read edge is asserted-but-unsubstantiated (unsourced), its "gambling undiminished" edge is unasserted (missing). supported=0 is forced by the registry, not by lean: content/sources.json carries four entries, one primary PPATK figures release plus three outlet corroborations, and none states a causal path in either direction. counts recompute correctly against contracts/types.ts (unsourced = 2 edges + 5 ev-less hidden entries = 7; missing 1; hidden 7; conflicts 4).

CLEARED, dimensions 2 and 4 (hidden-branch count and depth). Of 7 hidden cards, jt-h1, jt-h4 and jt-h5 are bidirectional (h5 explicitly: "can only continue or break that fall"); the rest are gap claims, not assertions (h6 is modal in both languages, "A market CAN show" / "Pasar DAPAT menunjukkan"). The strongest mirror-side fact in the evidence set is carried at full strength rather than buried: the dueling panel gives net deposits, the single-count series, both years (Rp51.3T -> Rp36.01T, a 29.8 percent fall against turnover's 20.3 percent), with a method line equal in length and specificity to turnover's, and rule_line is even-handed ("neither add together nor stand in for each other"). Neither series is examined while the other is summarised. jt-h3's label naming crypto, offshore gateways and informal top-up sellers with no ev was examined and cleared: it carries no ev, so the artifact's own counts machinery discloses it as unsourced alongside every other ev-less card, and its why is a strict gap claim. The one registry datum bearing on recording coverage (id-antara-judol-q1-2026 note: QRIS about 78.5 percent of 2025 deposit frequency) is omitted, and that omission is defensible symmetrically: it conditions on the observed set and so cannot bound off-rail flow, it is frequency not value, and it is 2025 not the Q1-2026 period. A mirror audit would exclude it for the same reasons.

CLEARED, dimensions 3 and 5 (temperature, burden of proof) and rules C1/C8. "states" is the single verb used for what sources do and do not do and for the artifact's own steps alike; no claims/says split, no scare quotes, no loaded adjectives, no concessive framing. Burden is distributed: sparring q0 burdens the gov inference (money must actually stop), q2 burdens an alarmist misreading by correcting 422.1 million transactions mistaken for players, q1 is neutral and its distractors guard against misusing the Q1 figure and against mixing the two series, errors available to either side. C1 lexicon scan over all 263 copy strings (contracts/lexicon.json verdict.en, verdict.id and the fact-check colon phrase, whole-word case-insensitive, not_copy_keys honoured): zero hits, including zero "salah satu" false positives. C8: zero em dashes, zero other Pd-category dashes, zero emoji.
